summary: PennantPark Private Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 137,883 common shares for about $3.57 million in its continuous private offering under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. The filing also disclosed net asset value per share of $25.89 as of July 31, 2026. This is a routine capital raise and NAV update, not a special situation. No strategic event, premium, or board action is involved; the transaction is a standard exempt offering. What to watch: ongoing NAV trends and continued subscription activity in the private offering.
